# B O - Order view page - The Invoice prefix is displayed in the customer language instead of the employee language

In the BO > Orders > Order view page, the Invoice prefix is displayed in the customer language instead of the employee's language
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/177958730-c24f94e4-e079-452c-9168-2604cf4b37e2.png)

## Étapes
1. Install a shop with multilanguage, for example English = language by default and French
2. Go to FO > Select French > Create an order
3. Go to BO > Orders > View last order created > Generate an invoice
4. See error > In the Product block, the Invoice Prefix = #Frxxxxx, it should #INxxxx as in the Documents tab



https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/177960975-87582291-7d31-489e-91c0-b216bf1d6591.mp4
